alex_w: Kicking off a key backfill to rewrap/encrypt envelopes to the new master key across AWS/GCP/Azure. Plan is staged per-region, small canary (1k items) -> ramp. Running 4 workers/region, target ~150 KMS ops/sec per region to start. Any red flags?
maria_g: Heads-up: KMS providers throttle differently. Recommend starting conservative. Also need to confirm whether we can use ReEncrypt API (AWS) or have to decrypt+encrypt (GCP).
samir_p: For AWS use ReEncrypt when possible so plaintext never leaves KMS. For GCP/Azure we might need decrypt+encrypt — do that inside a hardened worker with no logging. Also add encryption_context/job_id to each request for auditability.
luis_r: RBAC: workers need kms:Decrypt on old key and kms:Encrypt on new key (or kms:ReEncrypt if using that). Make a dedicated IAM role with least privilege and a short-lived session via STS. Also ensure keystore admin doesn't have broad permissions during the run.
alex_w: Good call. We'll create a new role `key-backfill-runner` and use ephemeral creds. How should we handle throttling/backoff? I'm expecting occasional ThrottlingException from KMS.
samir_p: Exponential backoff with full jitter + token-bucket to cap concurrency. If we see sustained throttling, automatically reduce target concurrency by 50% and stretch the window. Also add a per-item retry_count and move to DLQ after N attempts.

Example backoff pseudocode:
```
retry = 0
while retry < MAX_RETRIES:
  try call_kms()
  except ThrottlingException:
    sleep = random(0, base * 2**retry)
    sleep(sleep)
    retry += 1
  except FatalError:
    put_to_dlq(item, reason)
    break
```

maria_g: For progress tracking use a small checkpoint table (Dynamo/Spanner). Each worker should checkpoint a contiguous shard id + last_processed_key every N items so we can resume mid-shard without overlap. Record counts for success/failure per shard.
luis_r: Make updates idempotent: store rewrap_version and last_rewrapped_at on the envelope metadata and compare-before-write. Use conditional update so concurrent retries don't double-process. Example Dynamo update: `SET rewrap_version = :v, last_rewrapped_at = :t WHEN attribute_not_exists(rewrap_version) OR rewrap_version < :v`
sre_oncall: Monitoring knobs: emit metrics `rewrap.rate`, `rewrap.fail_rate`, `rewrap.kms_throttle_count`, per-region `rewrap.lag_ms`. Alert if fail_rate > 1% for 15m or if checkpoint lag > 30m. Also emit a heartbeat to oncall every 30m while job is running.

devops-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary job started in us-west-2 (job_id=jb-20260320-1). 1k items queued.
alex_w: Canary results: 1k items done, 3 failures both due to transient KMS throttling, auto-retried and succeeded on second attempt. Ramp to 10k per region tomorrow at 06:00 UTC.
maria_g: Audit: ensure all KMS calls include `encryption_context` with keys {job_id, shard_id, envelope_id} so CloudTrail/Stackdriver logs link to our job. We'll also export KMS audit logs to the security log bucket for long-term retention and run a post-run diff for unexpected callers.
samir_p: Error recovery plan: 
- transient KMS errors -> backoff + retry
- persistent auth/permission errors -> fail the worker and create a high-priority incident
- corrupted envelopes (decryption fails) -> move to quarantine bucket with metadata and investigator ticket
- too many retries -> DLQ + manual review pipeline

luis_r: For throughput gating we should implement adaptive pacing: measure KMS 5xx/429 and decrease concurrency per-region. Also rotate region-wide work windows so we don't spike all regions at once.

security-bot: [audit] Created ticket SEC-1123 to verify encryption_context usage and retained logs.
alex_w: One more: rolling key rotation during the backfill? We must freeze key admin rotations for the duration of the backfill window or ensure new keys are compatible. Propose a maintenance window and a freeze flag in buy-in docs.
sre_oncall: If backfill hits unexpected latency, fallback to partial-swap: serve with both old+new encryption until we can finish rewrap in background. Make sure feature flags exist to prefer new key only when `rewrap_version == target`.
maria_g: Can we run a parallel rewrap for hot partitions first (most accessed buckets) to reduce application risk? Prioritize by recent read/write volume.
alex_w: Yes — priority list = hot partitions first. We'll stage: canary -> hot partitions -> bulk -> cleanup. Plan to run the bulk during low-traffic windows and auto-scale workers down if KMS throttle alarms fire.
samir_p: After completion, run a verification pass that samples items per-shard and confirms `decrypt_with(new_key)` succeeds and `encryption_context.job_id` matches. Save a signed report to the compliance bucket.
luis_r: Also add a post-run audit that lists any principals who called KMS during window besides the backfill role — flag and review.
alex_w: OK - I'll draft the runbook with roles/steps, checkpoint schema, DLQ handling, and alert thresholds. Will ping for reviews by EOD. :thumbsup:
maria_g: I'll review RBAC and audit sections. Thanks.
